mapper.sql: id, name, short_name, registered_address, registered_latitude, registered_longitude, business_address, business_latitude, business_longitude, business_scope, business_status, unified_social_credit_code, legal_representative, registered_capital, establishment_date, business_term, official_phone, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, official_email, intro, logo_url, website, create_time, update_time, status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tour_company (name, short_name, registered_address, registered_latitude, registered_longitude, business_address, business_latitude, business_longitude, business_scope, business_status, unified_social_credit_code, legal_representative, registered_capital, establishment_date, business_term, official_phone, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, official_email, intro, logo_url, website, status, user_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{shortName}, #{registeredAddress}, #{registeredLatitude}, #{registeredLongitude}, #{businessAddress}, #{businessLatitude}, #{businessLongitude}, #{businessScope}, #{businessStatus}, #{unifiedSocialCreditCode}, #{legalRepresentative}, #{registeredCapital}, #{establishmentDate}, #{businessTerm}, #{officialPhone}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone}, #{officialEmail}, #{intro}, #{logoUrl}, #{website}, #{status}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT tc.*, u.username as user_name FROM tour_company tc LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON tc.user_id = u.id WHERE tc.id = #{id}
